mapper.select: SELECT result_tb.seq, date_format(result_tb.display_date, "%Y-%m-%d") as display_date, result_tb.status, result_tb.b2b_partner, result_tb.total_amount, result_tb.original_amount, result_tb.interest_amount, result_tb.fee_amount, result_tb.return_amount, result_tb.remain_amount FROM ( # 신청 데이터 SELECT hbbri.seq, hbbri.execute_req_date AS display_date, '신청' AS status, '비밀특가' AS b2b_partner, hbbri.total_payment AS total_amount, '' AS original_amount, '' AS interest_amount, '' AS fee_amount, '' AS return_amount, '' AS remain_amount FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO hbbri LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO mui ON hbbri.seq = mui.SEQ WHERE mui.USER_NO = '1' AND date_format(hbbri.execute_req_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{fromDate} AND date_format(hbbri.execute_req_date, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate} UNION ALL # 입금 데이터 SELECT hbbri.seq, hbbri.deposit_date AS display_date, '입금' AS status, '비밀특가' AS b2b_partner, hbbri.total_payment AS total_amount, '' AS original_amount, '' AS interest_amount, '' AS fee_amount, '' AS return_amount, '' AS remain_amount FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO hbbri LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO mui ON hbbri.seq = mui.SEQ WHERE mui.USER_NO = '1' AND date_format(hbbri.deposit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{fromDate} AND date_format(hbbri.deposit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate} UNION ALL # 상환 데이터 SELECT hbbr.seq, hbbr.repayment_date AS display_date, '상환' AS status, '비밀특가' AS b2b_partner, hbbr.total_repayment_amount AS total_amount, hbbr.original_amount, hbbr.interest_amount, hbbr.fee_amount, hbbr.total_return_amount AS return_amount, mui2.AVAILABLE_AMOUNT AS remain_amount FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_REPAYMENT hbbr LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO hbbri ON hbbr.seq = hbbri.seq LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO mui2 ON hbbr.SEQ = mui2.SEQ WHERE hbbr.seq = mui2.SEQ AND date_format(hbbr.repayment_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{fromDate} AND date_format(hbbr.repayment_date, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate} ) AS result_tb WHERE result_tb.seq = #{SEQ} ORDER BY display_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_EVALUATE ( division, object_no, eval_subject, reviewer, title, detail, input_date )values( '02', #{SEQ}, #{eval_subject}, #{reviewer}, #{title}, #{detail}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT user_no, seq, inform_type, tel_inform_detail, date_format(tel_inform_date,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as tel_inform_date, informer_id FROM CBCI_ADV_CAL_RECEIPT_TEL WHERE USER_NO = #{USER_NO} AND SEQ = #{SEQ} ORDER BY tel_inform_date DESC

SELECT user_no, seq, inform_type, tel_inform_detail, date_format(tel_inform_date,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as tel_inform_date, tel_informer_nm, confirm_yn, informer_id, input_date, update_date FROM CBCI_ADV_CAL_RECEIPT_TEL WHERE USER_NO = #{USER_NO} AND SEQ = #{SEQ} AND input_date IN (SELECT MAX(input_date) FROM CBCI_ADV_CAL_RECEIPT_TEL)
